description: This file implements a returns service for an e-commerce frontend, handling creation, listing, and approval of return requests with mock and backend fallback mechanisms, utilizing localStorage and API endpoints.

methods.name: readLocal
methods.description: Reads return requests from localStorage, parsing JSON and returning an array.

methods.name: writeLocal
methods.description: Writes a list of return requests to localStorage as JSON.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a return request.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Determines the base URL for backend API calls based on environment variables.

methods.name: tryBackend
methods.description: Attempts to perform a fetch request to the backend API with error handling.

methods.name: uploadProof
methods.description: Uploads proof images for returns; in mock mode creates object URLs, in backend mode posts multipart data.

methods.name: createReturn
methods.description: Creates a return request, storing in localStorage or sending to backend, with auto-approval for damaged items with photos.

methods.name: listReturns
methods.description: Lists all return requests, fetching from backend or localStorage fallback.

methods.name: getReturnById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return request by ID from backend or localStorage fallback.

methods.name: approveInstantRefund
methods.description: Mocks approval and refund of a return request, updating localStorage or calling backend.
